prompt: Hand-split cedar roof shingles in overlapping courses, colonial New England meeting house, seen from directly overhead. Perfectly overhead orthographic seamless square albedo texture, filling the frame edge to edge. No perspective, no object edges, no background, no border, no cast shadows, no lighting gradient, no vignette. Opposite edges tile invisibly. Flat even illumination. Boston, Massachusetts, 1765. Muted, weathered, working-town palette; nothing new, nothing bright, nothing modern. No modern materials, no plastic, no paint, no machine-perfect repetition.
